ktte01.title: Aries Has One Second
ktte01.caption:
Call or text? One second to pick. Aries never hesitates, until the card says sorry first.
Fast at everything. Even apologies.

ktte02.title: Taurus Won't Let Go
ktte02.caption:
Missing someone at 11 p.m. and the phone is right there?
Taurus put the ex card down and texted a friend instead.

ktte03.title: Gemini, Pick One
ktte03.caption:
Can you pick just one? Gemini tried. Twice.
When it counts, the honest answer is the only one you need.

ktte04.title: Left on Read: Spiral or Chill
ktte04.caption:
Left on read. Is your brain already writing the worst ending?
Cancer waited it out and called a friend. Busy is not a verdict.

ktte05.title: Leo, Ask About Them
ktte05.caption:
Big entrance or quiet one? Leo knows. But the real choice came last.
Ask about them. Watch them light up.

ktte06.title: Virgo Made a Pro and Con List
ktte06.caption:
Two options and you made a list with tabs? Same, Virgo.
Perfect can wait. Being there is the part they remember.

ktte07.title: Libra, Your Vote Counts
ktte07.caption:
Do you say whatever you want and mean it less every time?
Libra finally picked what it wanted. Your vote counts too.

ktte08.title: Scorpio, Guess or Ask
ktte08.caption:
They said haha. With a period. Is that bad?
Scorpio stopped decoding and just asked. Faster than guessing.

ktte09.title: Sagittarius Saw 'What Are We?'
ktte09.caption:
Someone asked what are we and you went quiet?
Sagittarius picked freedom every time. Then picked someone to tell it all to.

ktte10.title: Capricorn, Are You Fine?
ktte10.caption:
Say I'm fine, do it alone, repeat. Sound like you?
Capricorn finally said not really, and got a hug. Strong people get those too.
